body: New promptoverse_backoff.go: persisted consecutive-failure state consulted before the FIRST request of a new drain, not just mid-run retries. Linear 30s/failure capped at 5min, 15min staleness reset. --force skips the wait, keeps recording. 8 new tests. Commit cecabd8.
title: Prompt-o-verse: adaptive cross-invocation backoff + --force flag
